conf.description: aws-guardduty findings / asff: Security Hub ASFF re-normalization of GuardDuty findings. Per recommendations.direct.cribl this is NOT the native guardduty data stream - routed to event.dataset 'aws_securityhub.findings' instead of 'aws_guardduty.findings', since the elastic recommendation explicitly says 'Route this to a logs-aws.securityhub data stream... not the guardduty pipeline.' ProductFields/Resources/Types are carried through unflattened (custom fields) rather than re-derived, since flattening/recovering the native GuardDuty network-DNS signal from ProductFields is named only in the Elastic-side recommendation.

conf.comment: aws-guardduty / findings / asff. This is a Security Hub feed that happens to carry GuardDuty detections, not the native GuardDuty finding schema - the native typed service.action.* network/DNS/API fields are collapsed into free-text ProductFields keys on this path (the map's own framing). Two export shapes exist per the work order: an EventBridge envelope ({"detail-type":"Security Hub Findings - Imported","detail":{...}}) or a bare GetFindings API record - a `code` step detects and unwraps the former, a no-op on the latter. ASSUMPTION: one finding per record (no detail.findings[] multi-finding split attempted - no verified event-splitting function conf exists in the brief for this; flagged in the README). Severity/Workflow.Status are genuinely nested ASFF JSON, not flat dotted keys, so chained bracket access is safe here (not the Zeek flat-dot landmine). event.dataset intentionally overridden per recommendations.direct.cribl - see description. Direct route, no guard hop.

functions.description: record dataset, format, the EventBridge-vs-API envelope handling, and the event.dataset routing override
deserialize the ASFF (or EventBridge-wrapped ASFF) JSON into fields

conf.code: if (__e['detail'] !== undefined && __e['detail-type'] === 'Security Hub Findings - Imported') { var _d = __e['detail']; var _f = (_d.findings !== undefined && Array.isArray(_d.findings) && _d.findings.length > 0) ? _d.findings[0] : _d; for (var _k in _f) { __e[_k] = _f[_k]; } }

functions.description: detect and unwrap the EventBridge envelope (finding fields land at top level either way); a no-op when the record is already a bare ASFF finding from the GetFindings API export

compute every unmapped/custom field from ORIGINAL vendor names before the rename - Severity.Normalized kept as ASFF's native 0-100 int rather than rescaled (the map offers either option; keeping the native scale is the simpler, non-lossy choice - see README); ProductFields/Resources/Types kept as their natural nested JSON shape, unflattened, per the Cribl-vs-Elastic scope split
batch-rename the eleven clean 1:1 top-level ASFF fields to their ECS targets

ISO8601 UpdatedAt into _time (never @timestamp, constraint 1); as on the native finding feed, an aggregated finding re-stamps this forward on each occurrence, so event.created/event.start hold the original/first-observed times separately

tag event.dataset overridden to the securityhub stream per recommendations.direct.cribl (no hyphen, constraint 5) and event.provider distinguishing this from the native GuardDuty feed for dedup; drop the clean-named originals consumed above plus any leftover EventBridge envelope keys (harmless no-op removal when the record was already a bare API export)
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
